# 太 + Adjective + 喇 · *taai3 + Adjective + laa3*

**Meaning:** too (much) · **Level:** A2 · **Topic:** Degree and comparison

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new).

太 before an adjective means 'too'. It is very often followed by 喇, which marks the situation as having gone past what's acceptable.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **太貴喇！** |
| Jyutping | taai3 gwai3 laa3! |
| Yale | taai gwai la! |
| Bopomofo | ㄊㄚㄧ³ ㄍㄨㄜㄧ³ ㄌㄚ³! |
| English | That's too expensive! |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **呢杯咖啡太甜喇。** |
| Jyutping | ni1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 taai3 tim4 laa3. |
| Yale | nī būi ga fē taai tìhm la. |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄧ¹ ㄅㄨㄧ¹ ㄍㄚ³ ㄈㄝ¹ ㄊㄚㄧ³ ㄊㄧㆬ⁴ ㄌㄚ³. |
| English | This coffee is too sweet. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你行得太快喇。** |
| Jyutping | nei5 haang4 dak1 taai3 faai3 laa3. |
| Yale | néih hàahng dāk taai faai la. |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄏㄚㄥ⁴ ㄉㄜㆶ¹ ㄊㄚㄧ³ ㄈㄚㄧ³ ㄌㄚ³. |
| English | You're walking too fast. |
